$Comment: The quest that hands a player the Disenchanting Table: bring Enchanter Orrin the makings and
he builds it. It opens once the introduction to him is claimed, so his first real job is
offered to somebody who has already stood in front of him; that introduction in turn waits on
the temple meeting, because Orrin stands in the temple and nowhere else and a quest whose giver
the player cannot reach would sit parked and unpaid. It is the first rung of the disenchanting
chain, so the quest book lists its successors under it.
The two deliveries are the iron and the Life essence the table's own recipe asks for (the wood
and stone Orrin has to hand), so a player who has read that recipe knows why the counts are
what they are. Both sit on Order 1 and hand in to Orrin only (TurnInNpcId 'giver'), so they
can be brought in either order. The reward sits in the Claim bucket, so the table and the
Enchanting XP wait in the quest log once both are delivered, until the player collects them.
CompletionDialogue names Orrin's conversation, so settling it at him plays his next line, which
is where he offers the next job.
With this pack installed the table is never crafted: the pack ships the block with no Recipe,
so this quest (and A Second Table after it) is where a table comes from. Requires.Factors
carries the stations feature, which is on when RPG Stations is installed and enabled; with it
off this quest does not exist, and neither does Orrin. AutoAccept is off deliberately: an
optional beat off the main tutorial branch, offered from Orrin's own lines.
To retune the ask, edit the two Amounts; to change the payout, edit Rewards. The table itself
is the first entry, so replacing or removing it changes what this quest is actually for.
Name: The_Lesser_Table
